implemented: Publication prepare/verify/commit: full SHA-256 streaming outside SQL transactions, retained descriptors, four verification slots, bounded bytes/deadline, final authorization/receipt/revision/metadata/storage-key and stat/path identity revalidation.

Actual post-publication same-size corruption reproduced (expected 503, previously 206), then fixed with bounded file-signature integrity cache and current SQL authorization on each public/review request. Tested inode replacement, in-place rewriting with restored mtime, revoke-during-hash and storage-key substitution.

Bounded process-local HTTP/query/transaction/publication/job/processing/error histograms; sanitized request path categories; admin-only no-store diagnostics with pool/cache/backlog/quota/orphan/memory data. Worker metrics/resources in protected heartbeat; actual Docker worker emits ready processing metrics.
Future/unknown schema startup refusal, explicit HTTP/readiness quarantine, Compose propagation and worker pre-connection refusal. No destructive database migration or new table.

Operator-only protected takedown ledger export and monotonic, transactional, repeat-safe reconciliation; exact matching PostgreSQL archive/media restore exercised under quarantine before controlled reopening. Listener data preserved.

API resource budget 1 CPU/384 MiB, worker 1 CPU/512 MiB; image healthchecks and non-root users verified. Docker media dependency layer moved before source to avoid repeating FFmpeg install for ordinary source changes.
Existing M1/M2 authentication, ownership, CSRF, progress/history revisions, playlist concurrency, publication/revocation, Redis failure/recovery and real SIGKILL/outbox/fencing regressions pass.

HTTP publication commit revalidates the live server-derived session after media verification, matching existing upload-completion security. Logged-out/expired requests cannot commit when invalid before the final session check; transactions already past final authorization are not retroactively cancelled.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Hashing under account locks blocked contenders.
findingsAndCorrections.evidence: Final sequential matched baseline/current benchmark uses real eight-minute processed audio and explicit storage-hook synchronization. See actual p50/p95/p99 and CPU/RSS/pool results.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Move streaming hash outside locks, retain and revalidate proof; SQL commit still performs bounded metadata opens/stats.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Initial benchmark probe included remaining publisher time in lock wait.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Corrected completion at contender COMMIT, synchronized at storage entry, and reran both actual revisions sequentially; exploratory incorrect/overlapping runs excluded.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Same-size damaged MP3 could stream after technical approval.
findingsAndCorrections.evidence: A new test failed before fix with 206 instead of 503; both database versions now pass, including a warmed signature cache.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Verify checksum on signature-cache miss, fresh OS signature each request, retain independent current SQL authorization.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: First proof implementation closed its retained descriptor at stream EOF and an early rights check changed receipt precedence.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Retain descriptor after successful hash; validate existing receipt/revision before rights as before. Existing assertions unchanged and final suite passes.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Recovery flag was initially absent from Compose and worker startup.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Explicit environment propagation and startup refusal before DB/Redis; unit and actual Docker image verify it.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: New worker-start test originally used a root-relative path that failed under npm server-workspace cwd.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Resolve script path from import.meta.url; keep exit/error assertions unchanged; final full suite passes.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: Initial mandatory browser run stalled at currentTime 0.133673, paused=false, readyState=4, with no media error.
findingsAndCorrections.result: Unchanged isolated auth/audio scenario and entire mandatory rerun passed. No sleeps, retries added to assertions or weakened playback checks. Exact environmental/root cause is NOT established; retain as a local browser reliability concern.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: First bounded Docker build timed out during cold dependency installation.
findingsAndCorrections.result: Detailed manual build completed (including a slow FFmpeg download/install); final real bounded Docker drill passes. Layer ordering now prevents source changes invalidating media-package install. Cold external-download timing is not guaranteed.

findingsAndCorrections.finding: A delayed HTTP publication could commit after its initiating session was logged out or expired.
findingsAndCorrections.evidence: An isolated pre-fix prepare/verify protocol variant returned 200 where the corrected regression requires 401; final PostgreSQL and SQLite tests exercise both logout and expiry.
findingsAndCorrections.fix: Pass the server-derived session hash separately from request fields and revalidate the session in the authorized commit transaction. Receipt semantics and current-account isolation remain intact.
findingsAndCorrections.harnessCorrection: The first draft incorrectly expected logout 200; corrected to the existing 204 contract before reproducing actual stale publication.

remainingP0.verifiedLocalScope: No known unfixed P0 regression in exercised paths.
remainingP0.releaseConditions: Not an unconditional production release: actual provider security, drained/fenced old credentials/writers, coordinated backup and latest identity/session/takedown reconciliation must be approved and verified before exposure.

remainingP1: Privileged filesystem/kernel writers can change bytes after final checks; metadata syscalls under final commit can still hang. Tested stat/signature checks do not eliminate SQL/filesystem TOCTOU or prove safety against hostile root.

Quarantine is opt-in and must be set before restore. Latest ledger authenticity/completeness and post-backup roles/sessions/creator suspensions require trusted operator reconciliation. Previously downloaded/buffered/exported copies cannot be recalled.
Existing automatic startup migrations/seed and runtime DB-role privileges need provider-specific release review; unknown-schema refusal cannot retrofit fencing into already shipped old binaries.
No encrypted/offsite scheduled backup service, external telemetry retention/alerts, full disaster/OS-I/O-hang drill, cross-browser or real hosting configuration verification.
Broader roadmap items (universal catalog/library/progress pagination, OpenAPI, account-erasure/export and global disk/queue retention) are not implemented by this targeted checkpoint.

Benchmarks use seven fixture stories, 30 HTTP requests/concurrency 4 and eight publication cycles, warm local storage and one worker. p95/p99 of eight samples are maxima; no production-capacity/scalability inference. CPU/RSS cover the shared benchmark client/server process, not an isolated API or FFmpeg child peak.
Observed one transient Chrome playback stall and a cold Docker dependency timeout; final unchanged gates passed but causes/cold timing are not comprehensively resolved.
